message.text: I'm exploring the repository structure to locate the SignIn RPC handler.The ripgrep tool isn't working, so I'll switch to using shell grep or Glob instead.
Now I should locate the actual implementation, probably in the auth service file within the API router.
The real implementation is likely in APIV1Service.SignIn within auth_service.go, so I want to check that file to verify its signature matches the AuthService RPC.

This confirms it. The `APIV1Service` struct implements the `AuthServiceServer`/handler interface used by both the gRPC and Connect service registrations in `repo/server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go`, which delegates directly to this method.

q04.
`AuthService.SignIn` — `server/router/api/v1/auth_service.go` (method `(s *APIV1Service) SignIn`, line 51)

This is the core business-logic implementation of the `SignIn` RPC. It's wired up via `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go` (the `ConnectServiceHandler.SignIn` wrapper at line 78, which just calls through to `s.APIV1Service.SignIn`) to serve the request over both gRPC and Connect/HTTP transports.
